settings.model.label: Model
settings.model.description: Which Claude model answers. 'Account default' uses whatever your Claude Code login is set to.
settings.tools.label: Capabilities
settings.tools.description: Chat only runs with no tools at all. Read-only adds Read/Glob/Grep/WebSearch. Agent removes every permission prompt, so Claude can edit files and run commands in the working directory without asking.
settings.workdir.label: Working directory
settings.workdir.description: Directory the claude process runs in. It decides which project context and CLAUDE.md apply outside chat-only mode.
settings.system_prompt.label: Extra system prompt
settings.system_prompt.description: Appended to Claude's system prompt on every turn. Leave empty for the default behaviour.
settings.claude_bin.label: claude executable
settings.claude_bin.description: Command used to launch Claude Code. An absolute path works if it is not on Noctalia's PATH.
